documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
Disclosures under Reg. 29(1) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Bajaj Auto Limited reported record financial performance for Q1 FY27, with volumes reaching 1.4 million units, revenue crossing INR 17,000 crores, and EBITDA margins at 20.9%, driven by strong momentum in exports and electric vehicles despite supply chain disruptions and hyper-inflationary commodity costs. Management highlighted that capacity expansion of nearly 25% from 7 million units to 9 million units per annum is underway across EVs, high-end motorcycles, and three-wheelers. The company also executed a comprehensive portfolio makeover for domestic motorcycles, specifically focusing on the 125cc-plus segment with upcoming product launches. Additionally, consolidated results benefited from the full-quarter consolidation of Bajaj Mobility AG and robust performance from Bajaj Auto Credit Limited. Bajaj Auto reported a record-setting performance for Q4 and FY26, driven by growth across all business units, robust operational management, and record revenues exceeding INR58,000 crores and EBITDA crossing INR12,000 crores.

guidance.claim: Management estimates motorcycle industry growth will slow to 7% to 9% in the near term.
guidance.quote: This is bound to slow down the motorcycle category from its rocking 20% growth in Q4 to we estimate 7% to 9% in the near term.

guidance.claim: The management expects export growth momentum to continue in the coming months.
guidance.quote: Overall, the Exports business has established a sustained growth momentum, and we expect this growth tempo to continue in the coming months.

guidance.claim: The company expects the motorcycle industry to continue growing at 12% to 15%.
guidance.quote: We expect this growth momentum in the industry to continue and the motorcycle industry to continue to grow at, say, 12% to 15%.

guidance.claim: The company expects to outpace industry growth in the 125cc plus segment and particularly the 150cc plus segment.
guidance.quote: Therefore, we expect to outpace industry growth in the 125cc plus segment and particularly in the 150cc plus segment and continue on the path of market share acquisition, which has commenced a couple of months ago.

guidance.claim: The management expects to grow its 3-wheeler leadership position decisively in the coming quarters.
guidance.quote: We expect to grow our leadership position quite decisively in the coming quarters.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for electric vehicles surged due to operating economics and concerns over fuel bills arising from the West Asia crisis.
demand_outlook.quote: Now because of the West Asia crisis and the impact on petrol, and generally on people feeling that the fuel bill might just go out of their control, there has been a surge in adoption of electric vehicles.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment across both domestic and international markets in key segments remains positive.
demand_outlook.quote: Having said that, the demand environment, both in domestic and international, particularly in our key markets, is very positive, though the business environment may still be a bit volatile.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment softened in April due to general inflation, vehicle price increases, LPG shortages, and manpower migration.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment, it has softened in April due to general inflation, increased prices of our vehicles, LPG shortages, manpower migration and the LPG shortage-led effect on the consumer sentiment.

demand_outlook.claim: Post the GST rationalization, the domestic motorcycle industry grew by about 15% in Q3.
demand_outlook.quote: In fact, slipping to minus 3% in Q2. But post the GST rationalization, Q3 has grown by about 15% in the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic 3-wheeler ICE segment growth was bumped up to positive 4% to 5% following GST cuts.
demand_outlook.quote: The ICE segment was declining in April-August period by about 4%, but GST cuts have bumped up growth to positive 4% to 5%.

demand_outlook.claim: The 3-wheeler electric segment continues to drive the industry by growing at over 50%.
demand_outlook.quote: The Electric segment continues to drive the 3-wheeler industry by growing at about 50% plus.

demand_outlook.claim: Top 30 overseas markets grew by about 10% in the quarter while the company's sales grew at 15%.
demand_outlook.quote: The top 30 overseas markets collectively accounting for nearly 75% of the emerging market, industry grew by about 10% in this quarter with our sales growing at 15%, thereby signalling an increase of market share in these key markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is undertaking an expansion of manufacturing capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum to progressively reach 9 million units per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: So, with an eye on the future, we are undertaking an expansion of capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum across different businesses to progressively go up to 9 million units per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for the year was approximately INR500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV investments.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex for the year was approximately INR500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV investments.

capex_expansion.claim: The company strategically invested slightly above INR2,300 crores in the 9-month period into the Netherlands subsidiary BAIHBV and BACL.
capex_expansion.quote: We have strategically invested slightly above INR2,300 crores during this 9-month period into our Netherlands subsidiary, BAIHBV which you would recall was partly to fund the KTM acquisition and in the growth of BACL, which has steadily grown in scale and footprint.

capex_expansion.claim: Exclusive Chetak stores expanded to nearly 450 across 800 cities and towns.
capex_expansion.quote: The scale-up was also supported by distribution network that expanded to nearly 450 exclusive Chetak stores and 4,000 points of sale across 800 cities and towns.

capex_expansion.claim: Joint KTM-Triumph showrooms are planned to expand to over 100 by March.
capex_expansion.quote: We currently have about 50 KT showrooms operational and plan to expand these to over 100 by March.

margins_costs.claim: Commodity inflation intensified during the quarter, taking the overall inflationary impact to about 4.5% of revenue.
margins_costs.quote: Inflation across the metals complex accelerated meaningfully through May, taking the overall inflationary impact for the quarter to about 4.5% of revenue.

margins_costs.claim: Calibrated pricing actions implemented through April and June enabled the company to offset nearly half of the commodity inflation.
margins_costs.quote: And as I had indicated in the previous call, we responded with calibrated pricing very judiciously taken through April and June, enabling us to offset nearly about half of the inflation through pricing.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the quarter reached 20.9%, an improvement of 10 basis points sequentially.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins inched up to 20.9%, an improvement of 10 basis points sequentially despite the hyperinflationary commodity environment that I'd spoken about.

margins_costs.claim: Material cost inflation is estimated to be approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue based on the current outlook.
margins_costs.quote: Taken together, we are currently estimating a material cost inflation impact of approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue.

margins_costs.claim: The company has taken judicious pricing actions to offset about 40% of the material cost inflation impact so far.
margins_costs.quote: Once again, we have taken very judicious pricing actions to offset about 40% of this impact so far.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins expanded to 20.8%, up 30 basis points sequentially.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins expanded to 20.8%, up 30 basis points sequentially.

margins_costs.claim: The company recognized INR61 crores as a onetime exceptional charge towards past service cost under the new labour code.
margins_costs.quote: As you're all aware, pursuant to the amendment in the definition of wages under the new labour code, we recognized INR61 crores as a onetime exceptional charge towards the past service cost arising from the changes introduced under the new labour code.

orders_capacity.claim: Export volume set a new high of 732,000 units during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Exports business unit, the business unit established a new high of 7,32,000 units in the quarter and USD 735 million revenue in the quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Brazil manufacturing capacity has increased to 60,000 units per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales nearly 10,000 units during the quarter, supported by expanded manufacturing capacity, which has now increased to 60,000 units per annum, successful new product introductions like the 400 NS and wider market presence with almost 70 top-class stores.

orders_capacity.claim: Export volumes crossed the 600,000 units mark after 15 quarters.
orders_capacity.quote: The BU crossed the 200,000 average per month sales level in October '25 after nearly 40 months and maintained this level through the remainder of the quarter, surpassing the 600,000 units mark after 15 quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: The company continues to maintain a 70% plus market share in the ICE 3-wheeler segment.
orders_capacity.quote: We continue to maintain a 70% plus market share in the ICE segment with an overwhelming share of 85% plus in the CNG segment, which is the largest segment within ICE.

orders_capacity.claim: Retail Finance AUM crossed INR16,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: With penetration scaling to 45% levels, it has acquired over 3.5 lakh customers during the quarter and now has an AUM of over INR16,000 crores, and it has built a business driven by the twin pillars of digital first and robust operational management.

capital_allocation.claim: Surplus cash on the balance sheet stood in excess of INR 21,000 crores at the end of the June quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: The balance sheet continues to remain very healthy with surplus cash in excess of INR21,000 crores at the end of the June quarter, well managed and providing sufficient fuel for future growth investments, strategic opportunities and improved shareholder returns.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated over INR 2,300 crores of free cash flow during the quarter, translating to a cash conversion of almost 80% of profit after tax.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated over INR2,300 crores of free cash flow during this quarter, almost double that of the same period last year, translating into a cash conversion of almost 80% of profit after tax.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors approved a payout of 100% of the profits made last year, split between a final dividend and a buyback under the tender route.
capital_allocation.quote: Lastly, the Board of Directors at its meeting earlier today approved a payout of 100% of the profits that we have made last year in recognition of the 100 years milestone of the Bajaj family in India and with Bajaj Auto being the flagship company that started it all. his will be split as follows a final dividend of INR150 per share that will aggregate to INR4,192 crores and the balance of about INR5,633 crores will be towards a buyback under the tender route at a buyback price of INR12,000 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: The company closed the quarter with surplus cash of about INR15,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to deliver strong and consistent cash generation, closing the quarter with surplus cash of about INR15,000 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated nearly INR5,200 crores of free cash flow in the first 9 months of the year.
capital_allocation.quote: It's also worth noting that in the first 9 months of this year, we've generated nearly INR5,200 crores of free cash flow, and that was up 70% over the same period last year, reflecting our strong track record of converting profit to cash.

capital_allocation.claim: The last capital infusion into BACL was in October of about INR300 crores as Tier 2 capital.
capital_allocation.quote: The last infusion we did into BACL was in October of about INR300 crores. And that we think is absolutely the last of it that is needed. In fact, that infusion also went in as Tier 2 capital.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operations were temporarily suspended for a few days to conduct checks following a ransomware attack.
risks_headwinds.quote: It was a tough quarter with RM inflation, supply chain and logistics disruptions as well as a ransomware attack, which you may have read about, but it was defended comprehensively and successfully. Though exercising abundant caution, we suspended operations for a few days to complete thorough checks and investigations.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain issues and disruptions impaired availabilities by about 10% to 15%, particularly affecting exports, high-end bikes, and EVs.
risks_headwinds.quote: All of these above issues combined impaired availabilities by about 10% to 15%, more so in exports, high-end bikes and EVs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain difficulties in terms of LPG shortages, manpower availability, and outbound logistics impaired availability to service demand by about 10% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Supply chain difficulties in terms of the LPG shortage, manpower availability and outbound logistics to overseas markets have impaired availability to service demand by about 10% to 15%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Noble metals including platinum, palladium, and rhodium saw sharp increases, while aluminium, copper, nickel, and lead also continued to harden.
risks_headwinds.quote: Noble Metals especially platinum, palladium and rhodium all saw sharp increases, whilst aluminium, copper, nickel and lead also continued to harden.

risks_headwinds.claim: A net price versus cost inflation hit of nearly 50 basis points impacted the margin.
risks_headwinds.quote: As a result, we saw a net price versus cost inflation hit of nearly 50 basis points on the margin.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to accomplish an exhaustive portfolio makeover for the 150cc and 125cc segments within the next 6 weeks.
management_commitments.quote: Our aim is to accomplish this exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next 6 weeks.

management_commitments.claim: The exports business is targeted to move beyond the 250,000 per month level starting this quarter and onwards.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, the exports business, which like I said is 40% of our revenue, has established an outstanding growth momentum and we are looking at moving exports to beyond the 2,50,000 per month level this quarter and onwards.

management_commitments.claim: New introductions in the Pulsar brand hitting the market are expected as early as July.
management_commitments.quote: There will be hopefully, I think we will see these new introductions hitting the market as early as July in the Pulsar brand itself.

management_commitments.claim: Payouts for the buyback would essentially happen sometime in the second week of July likely.
management_commitments.quote: Looking at the fresh timelines, I would expect that payouts would essentially happen sometime in the second week of July likely.

management_commitments.claim: The exercise to build the top management team for KTM Austria will be completed by April 1.
management_commitments.quote: Second, build the top management team. The top deck is now largely in place, and the exercise will be completed by 1st April.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
